label: Capital Fleet
description: Capital-scale formations — whole fleets as a single subject, every item selling tonnage through concrete scale cues.

items.name: dreadnought-wedge
items.text: a wedge of kilometer-class dreadnoughts in staggered echelon, gun batteries the size of city blocks along each flank, escort frigates holding tight to the hulls like pilot fish

items.name: carrier-group
items.text: a fleet carrier at the center of its screen, launch bays glowing along the ventral spine, fighter wings streaming out of the catapult decks in ordered threads

items.name: colony-ark
items.text: a generation ark the size of a mountain range, habitat rings turning slowly amidships, its hull a geography of vents, domes and canyon-deep panel seams

items.name: refugee-convoy
items.text: a ragged refugee convoy of mismatched freighters and old liners, hull patches and improvised armor plating, holds strung with lit viewports like hillside villages

items.name: parade-escort
items.text: a ceremonial escort fleet in parade formation, polished hulls mirror-bright, signal lamps blinking in synchronized welcome patterns down the line

items.name: scarred-battle-group
items.text: a battle group limping home, scorched hulls open to vacuum in places, one cruiser under tow, running lights burning defiantly along every intact deck

items.name: harvester-fleet
items.text: a skimmer-harvester fleet trailing intake plumes, ram scoops glowing at the mouth, tanker bellies swollen and streaming condensate

items.name: leviathan-flagship
items.text: one leviathan flagship alone, so long its bow and stern hang under different weather, antenna spires combing through the cloud tops as it moves

items.name: drop-armada
items.text: an invasion drop armada disgorging landing craft in synchronized waves, drop pods streaking down ahead of it on parallel fire trails

items.name: survey-flotilla
items.text: a quiet survey flotilla at high anchor, sensor booms unfolded like insect antennae, hulls painted in high-visibility science orange against the sky
